terms.gloss: a young branch of a vine
evidence: Col. 5.6.26: palmitum duo genera sunt, alterum pampinārium, alterum frūctuārium (Lewis & Short)

terms.gloss: a vine tendril or vine leaf; a leafy vine shoot
evidence: Col. 3.18.4: ex gemmīs pampinī pullulant (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Sen. 53: ūva vestīta pampinīs (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: jam lentō turgent in palmite gemmae
phrases.english: now the buds are swelling on the pliant vine shoot

phrases.latin: heu male tum mītēs dēfendet pampinus ūvās
phrases.english: alas, the vine leaves will then be poor protection for the ripening grapes

sources: Lewis & Short: palmes · Lewis & Short: pampinus
